evals.name: reports-the-change-with-provenance-and-no-verdict
evals.expected_output: Runs the bundled audit-complexity.sh against the change (merge-base diff plus uncommitted files), presents the markdown report with its Coverage of this run table, the cyclomatic reference of 20 cited to ISO/IEC 5055:2021 section 8.2.117, and no reference for cognitive complexity or Halstead difficulty, and renders no pass/fail verdict.
expectations: Invokes the skill's scripts/audit-complexity.sh rather than estimating complexity by reading the code
Presents the Coverage of this run table naming the collector and version used per lane and measure
Cites ISO/IEC 5055:2021 section 8.2.117 for the cyclomatic reference of 20
States that cognitive complexity and Halstead difficulty carry no reference because no standard sets one
Does not declare any function a failure, defect, or violation

evals.name: a-missing-collector-is-visible-not-silent
evals.prompt: /code-metrics:audit-complexity src/ (this repository has no eslint-plugin-sonarjs and no lizard)
evals.expected_output: The report's run table shows the TypeScript cognitive row as unavailable with the reason, names the collector that did answer for cyclomatic complexity, offers the install hints without installing anything, and still reports every measure that a resolvable collector produced.
expectations: The run table carries an unavailable row with a reason for the measure whose collectors did not resolve
Offers the install hint without installing, downloading, or npx-fetching any collector
Still reports the measures the resolvable collectors produced rather than stopping
Reports an unmeasured value as null and never as zero

evals.name: json-feeds-a-comparison-through-the-gated-pointer
evals.prompt: /code-metrics:audit-complexity --json --all src/ so I can compare it after the refactor
evals.expected_output: Produces the code-metrics/v1 JSON document, keeps it for the comparison, and points at /verification:measure metrics only if the verification plugin is installed, otherwise explains the manual comparison and that an empty status is inconclusive.
expectations: Runs audit-complexity.sh with --json and keeps the document for the later comparison
Mentions /verification:measure only behind an if-installed gate with a stated fallback
States that a report with status empty on either side makes the comparison inconclusive
